name: ponchik_bench_barbell_a
prompt: The FIRST image is a sprite sheet of 8 frames (2 rows x 4 columns, read left to right, top row first), all 8 frames are the same picture of the fat black-and-white tomcat Ponchik lying on his back. Edit ONLY the masked area: redraw the arms so the 8 frames become ONE smooth bench-press push from the lowest point up: frame 1: the fists just above the chest, the elbows dropped beside the body; frames 2-8 push up in small, EVEN steps; frame 8 is the top: the fists above the head, the arms extended up but still a little bent at the elbows. Both front paws grip a BARBELL like the THIRD reference (a wooden stick with two bundles of tin cans tied with rope at its ends), always horizontal, the same size in every frame and fully visible, the fists hold the stick between the can bundles, about shoulder width apart, always at the same height. The arms keep their natural length and thickness (short chubby arms). Keep the head, the face (same grumpy expression), the body, the belly, the legs and the feet EXACTLY as they are in every frame, the barbell never covers the face. Colours, fur and line weight exactly like the SECOND reference. Keep the solid flat pure chroma-key GREEN (#00FF00) background everywhere, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame numbers.
